basePath.description:
The base path for the export files to be located
If not specified, the default is "AssetOnboardingExport".

batchSize.description:
The batch size to be used for the export job.
If not specified, the default is 2000.

trackingId.description:
An identifier that will be used to identify {@link AssetOnboardingExportJobBatchResult}s that will
be created in the job. This is necessary since {@link AssetOnboardingExportJob} is a singleton.

title: Options that can be provided when starting a {@link AssetOnboardingExportJob}.
name: AssetOnboardingExportJobOptions
